# Solution Input Summary
Program: MH-PROG-AGENTIC-CARE-DATA-ACCELERATOR

## Target outcomes
- Weekly clinical operations insight cadence.
- Reduced data reconciliation defects by 50% before cutover.
- Demonstrable compliance evidence coverage for PHI-sensitive retrieval.

## Constraints
- Existing Teradata workloads cannot be cut abruptly due to downstream dependencies.
- Limited specialized platform engineering capacity through Q2.
- Governance team requires deterministic evidence chain for high-risk decisions.

## Preferred path
- Governed Azure + Databricks modernization track with staged migration waves.
- Strong emphasis on evidence templates and readiness gates.
- Explicit anti-pattern monitoring in steering cadence.
